create_CheckpointHandler: create a CheckpointHandler instance to manage model checkpoints in a given experiment directory
save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with optional optimizer state and metrics history to disk
resume_checkpoint: resume training by loading a saved model checkpoint and optimizer state from a directory
list_available_checkpoints: list all available checkpoint files in a directory mapped by their epoch number
delete_old_checkpoints: delete old checkpoint files keeping only the current epoch and every Nth saved checkpoint
